name: Shadow Roll
body:
When you make a defensive roll while in the shadows, you are able to use your masterful dancing ability to evade attacks and you may use the ability an additional time that day.

Prerequisite(s): Perform (dance) 10 ranks, 5th-level shadowdancer

Benefit: When you use your defensive roll ability to avoid an otherwise lethal attack while you are in a dimly lit (or darker) area, you may make a Perform (dance) check in place of a Reflex saving throw (DC equal to the damage dealt) in order to lessen the effects of the attack. Additionally, you may use defensive roll one time per day while within a dimly lit area without it counting against your normal use of the defensive roll ability that day. Other than these effects, the defensive roll acts normally.
